title: List ingestion sources
summary: GraphQL query listIngestionSources(input: ListIngestionSourcesInput!). Returns urn, name, type, schedule, nested executions.

title: Create an ingestion source
summary: GraphQL mutation createIngestionSource(input: UpdateIngestionSourceInput!). type must match the recipe (postgres, oracle). config.recipe is a JSON-encoded recipe. config.executorId is the datahub-actions executor.

title: Update an ingestion source
summary: GraphQL mutation updateIngestionSource(urn, input: UpdateIngestionSourceInput!).

title: Create an ingestion execution request
summary: GraphQL mutation createIngestionExecutionRequest. Required input: ingestionSourceUrn. Returns the run / execution-request urn. datahub-actions executes it.

title: List execution requests
summary: GraphQL query listExecutionRequests. Poll result.status PENDING | RUNNING | SUCCESS | FAILURE.

title: Get one ingestion source
summary: GraphQL query ingestionSource(urn: String!).

title: Search across entities
summary: GraphQL query searchAcrossEntities. Use types DATASET, CONTAINER, DATA_JOB for asset counts in this lab. Not used for INGESTION_SOURCE run history.

title: Get a dataset by urn
summary: GraphQL query dataset(urn). Aspects such as schemaMetadata, upstreamLineage, datasetProperties.

title: GMS health
summary: datahub-gms process health. Mock returns ok=true.

title: GMS config
summary: Public GMS config payload (stateful ingestion flags, etc.). Mock returns a stub.

title: Ingest a metadata change proposal
summary: REST MCP apply. Alternative to GraphQL entity emit. Used by some CLI sinks.

title: Legacy entity search
summary: Older GMS search action. Prefer GraphQL searchAcrossEntities in new tests.

title: Postgres recipe coordinates
summary: host_port, username, database, schema_pattern.allow, table_pattern.allow. Sink datahub-rest to datahub-gms.

title: Oracle recipe coordinates
summary: host_port, username, service_name or database (not both), schema_pattern.allow.

title: datahub-gms
summary: Generalized Metadata Service. Serves GraphQL and REST. CPU/memory in this lab come from the metrics fixture.

title: datahub-mae-consumer
summary: Standalone MAE consumer. In this fixture it is CrashLoopBackOff after OOMKilled.

title: datahub-mce-consumer
summary: Standalone MCE consumer applying proposals.

title: datahub-frontend
summary: React UI. Public k8s docs port-forward 9002.

title: datahub-actions executor
summary: Runs UI and scheduled recipes. createIngestionExecutionRequest lands here.

title: Upstream lineage aspect
summary: upstreamLineage aspect on a dataset. Postgres views use include_view_lineage.

title: schemaMetadata aspect
summary: Column-level schema for a Dataset. SchemaField nullability and types.

title: Container entities
summary: Database and schema map to Container subtypes DATABASE and SCHEMA.

title: DataJob stored procedures
summary: Postgres stored procedures ingest as DataJob under a DataFlow per schema when include_stored_procedures is true.

title: OpenAPI entity read
summary: OpenAPI v2 entity GET. Mock returns a stub dataset document.

title: browseV2
summary: Browse containers in the UI. Not required for this lab's API tests.

title: datahub-rest sink
summary: Recipe sink that posts to datahub-gms. server: http://datahub-gms:8080 in this lab.

title: aggregateAcrossEntities
summary: Facet counts. This lab's mock also answers a compact assetCounts query used by tests.
